name: Quality rating
pick: A reading test: people read each text (for example machine translations or generated answers) and rate it on a scale: fluency, adequacy, quality, helpfulness.
summary: Read texts and rate how well they are written, from 1 to 5.
suggest: Ask if people are native speakers

examples.question: How fluent is this text?
examples.secondQuestion: How well does it keep the meaning?

settings.title: How well is it written?
settings.instructions: Read each text carefully, then rate it. 1 means very poor, 5 means as good as a careful native writer.
settings.question: How fluent and natural is this text?
